classification.difficultyReason: Same-arc angle gives CAD, then angles on a straight line through the exterior angle.

answer.worked:
An exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral equals the opposite interior angle, so $\angle BCD=110^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle CDB&=180^\circ-110^\circ-28^\circ\\&=42^\circ\end{align*}$$
$x=42^\circ$ because angles on the same arc $BC$ are equal.
